Anna (Support): Customer reports promo code rejected as \"invalid/expired\" when applying from account settings. User email: caroline+trial@example.com
Anna (Support): Promo they pasted: TRIAL-2025-ZERO
Anna (Support): Attached screenshot and copy-paste: https://redwood-internal/attachments/abc123
Miguel (Support): Can you paste the exact string they used (including surrounding chars)? sometimes copying from mobile adds invisible chars
Anna (Support): Pasted it above, but will DM the raw clipboard. Also tried via curl and got 400: {\"error\":\"promo.invalid_code\"}
Miguel (Support): Thanks. Quick check: I ran a quick curl using code as provided and got 400 as well. Repro steps:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" -d '{\"code\":\"TRIAL-2025-ZERO\",\"account_id\":\"acct_12X\"}'
```

Response:

```
{ \"error\": \"promo.invalid_code\", \"message\": \"Code not found or expired\" }
```

Miguel (Support): However when I copy the code from our promo table and call the same endpoint with that string it succeeds. Suspect invisible character or normalization issue.
Priya (Billing): I checked promo row: code is `TRIAL-2025-ZERO`, active until 2025-12-31 UTC, usage limit not hit. Nothing wrong in DB.
Anna (Support): User insists it was accepted on another account earlier today.
billing-bot: Promo lookup: code not found for provided string (length=17, hex: 54 52 49 41 4C 2D 32 30 32 35 2D 5A 45 52 4F) — mismatch with canonical (length=18)
billing-bot: Detected extra byte 0xE2 at pos 12 (likely ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE)
Miguel (Support): Aha. That explains length mismatch. Copy-paste likely added U+FEFF or U+200B. Can we add trimming/normalization on apply API?
eng-oncall: Filing a quick ticket ENG-7891 to normalize incoming promo codes (strip ZWNBSP/U+FEFF/U+200B and trim). Assigning to @sara-eng
eng-oncall: Also adding a small metric to track promo apply failures by mismatch length.
Priya (Billing): In the meantime we should manual-credit the user's account. Anna, can you confirm email and grant temporary credits?
Anna (Support): Done — granted 100 USD credit, noted reason \"promo invisible char\". User notified and credits apply. Ticket #CS-4129
Miguel (Support): For the fix: propose server-side normalize: NFC normalize + remove \u200B\uFEFF\u200C whitespace and full trim. I'll attach a small patch to ENG-7891.
Anna (Support): Closing loop with user, they confirmed promo works after manual code we applied. Will keep ENG ticket open. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Billing): Thanks team. Recommend adding a small FAQ blurb about copy-paste issues and to avoid zero-widths. :memo:
Anna (Support): Filed KB-105: \"Promo codes rejected due to hidden characters\" with repro steps + curl example.
